source.reference: The safe counterpart of the mig-001 hazard: nullable column with a default, CONCURRENTLY index, backfill and NOT NULL deferred to later migrations

defect: None. The migration is expand/contract and takes no lock that blocks writes.
why_it_is_hard: It is deliberately adjacent to mig-001. A reviewer that has learned 'a migration in the diff means block' fails here, and that failure is a false block on a correct change — the false-block rate the corpus holds a reviewer to caps at 25%.
notes: Round two: ac_3 restated. Round one asked for proof that the migration does not block writes, which no test in this tree can give, and the reviewer correctly returned cannot_determine 3/3. The criterion now names what the SQL must contain, which is checkable by reading it. Pre-registered before the round-two re-run.
